description: This file defines routing structures and methods for the go-restful package, including Route struct, route matching, and request wrapping functions.

classes.name: Route
classes.description: Represents an HTTP route with method, path, handlers, and metadata.

methods.name: postBuild
methods.description: Initializes route by tokenizing path and detecting custom verbs.

methods.name: wrapRequestResponse
methods.description: Creates wrapped Request and Response objects from HTTP request and response writer.

methods.name: matchesAccept
methods.description: Checks if route can produce a given MIME type.

methods.name: matchesContentType
methods.description: Checks if route can consume a given MIME type.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the route (method + path).

methods.name: EnableContentEncoding
methods.description: Enables or disables content encoding (GZIP/Deflate) for the route.
